usedFor: SuperSaaS holds appointments and users, and Freshsales Classic receives changes to deals through “Update Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Appointment” in SuperSaaS, then “Update Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: A booked appointment shows a deal moving, and the action updates its stage.

watchOut: “Appointment Changes” in SuperSaaS fires on creation, change and deletion, so “Update Deal” can run for a cancellation.
